snippet.title: NUTSHOT SIMULATOR — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Throw things. Hit groins. That's the whole game.

NUTSHOT SIMULATOR is a comedy physics shooting gallery: 17 hand-built levels of mundane-yet-zany places — a wedding, an aquarium, a construction site, a symphony orchestra, Venice Beach — each packed with characters who absolutely have it coming.

No score. No timer. Just a full ragdoll physics sim that makes every hit land a little differently.

🥜 Wishlist NUTSHOT SIMULATOR on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4872180?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social

🌐 https://nutshotsimulator.com

🎵 Music: "Morning Mood" from Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46 — Edvard Grieg.
Performed by the Czech National Symphony Orchestra for the Musopen Kickstarter Project (2012) and released into the PUBLIC DOMAIN by Musopen, the rights holder. The composition is public domain (Grieg died 1907).
Recording source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Grieg_-_Peer_Gynt_Suite_No._1,_Op._46_-_I._Morning_Mood_(Musopen_Symphony).flac
